lines: Then pot, kalasa, mandala, fire, own-self —
then, enriched by the Lord two-nature-juice,
flowers and rest: special-worship let him do.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tataḥ kumbhe kalaśe maṇḍale agnau svātmani ca abhedabhāvanayā pañcādhikaraṇam anusaṃdhiṃ kuryāt tataḥ parameśvarādvayarasabṛṃhitena puṣpādinā viśeṣapūjāṃ kuryāt

reads_against.argmap: What is the five-ground conjunction? → Pañcādhikaraṇa-saṃdhi: five vessels joined by abhedabhāvanā, then viśeṣa-pūjā with puṣpādi enriched by parameśvara-advaya-rasa.
c1_essence: Five grounds — pot, kalasa, mandala, fire, self — joined by non-difference; special-worship with the Lord two-nature-juice's flowers.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with vidhi weight (quiescence carrying rite-order)
